---
title: "My Penguins"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Summary table

```{r}
#| label: bill-table

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    avg_bill_length_mm = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

## Plot

```{r}
#| label: bill-plot
#| warning: false

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Bill length vs. bill depth",
    x = "Bill length (mm)",
    y = "Bill depth (mm)"
  )
```
